title: Universal Ethical Principles & Patient Rights
goal: Use formal plural cualesquiera que, past-tense universal relatives and postposed cualquiera in medical ethics.

items: I can use plural *cualesquiera que sean* and past-tense *cualquiera que fuera* / *quienquiera que* + imperfect subjunctive.
I can recognise the meaning shift of postposed *cualquiera* ('just any / ordinary') after a singular noun.
I can use core terms for medical conditions, palliative care, transplants, donors and health equity.
